verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own Community and Enterprise self-host editions let users run it on their own infrastructure with full data ownership, including on-prem. That effectively lets them decide where data lives, but there is no documented region or residency choice for Hoppscotch Cloud. missing for 10: cloud region/data-residency selection, explicit residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-host Hoppscotch on your own infrastructure with full data ownership.
For full data ownership and control over your API development and testing, you can self-host Hoppscotch on your infrastructure.
SAML-based SSO, on-prem deployment, audit logs, and more.
Choose between Community Edition and Enterprise Edition.
